turns.reply: The three SVG export tests now fail because they compare against the old `font-style: bold` snapshot. That is expected from this change, and I'm not permitted to edit tests. Submitting the patch.

I changed the bold `@font-face` in the SVG export template (`rich/_export_format.py`) from `font-style: bold` to `font-style: normal`, keeping `font-weight: 700`. `font-style` only accepts `normal`, `italic` or `oblique`, so the old value was invalid CSS.

Three existing SVG export tests in `tests/test_console.py` (`test_export_svg`, `test_export_svg_specified_unique_id`, `test_save_svg`) now fail because they compare against the old snapshot. I did not edit them, since test files are off-limits. I also could not confirm the change matches the upstream fix for issue 3943, because the issue text is only "fix fonts".
